correctness.rationale: For F(b,y)=(b,y+α(b)), Bowen iterate is (b,y+jα(b)). For fixed ε a finite base net and initial fiber net, combined with ε/(8n) covering of E=α(B), gives g_F(n,ε)≤C_ε N_E(ε/(8n)): velocity differences accumulate by at most n times their torus distance, regardless of α continuity modulus. Conversely choose a 4ε/n-separated subset of E, lift each to a base point and zero fiber; for any pair some coordinate circular distance δ≥4ε/n. If δ≥ε the first iterate separates; otherwise j=ceil(ε/δ)<n for sufficiently large n, and ε≤jδ<2ε<1/2 prevents wrap, producing separation. Covering/packing equivalence at radius proportional to 1/n proves hpol=upper box dimension, and hence zero topological entropy. Koch Jordan snowflake boundary has dimension log4/log3, lies inside small R² disk, gives continuous circle surjection α and a T³ Haar-preserving skew product homotopic to identity; its orbitwise rotation set is noncollinear curve and invariant-measure averages give convex hull, different notions kept separate.
